Standard returns: Returns are free within the UK. If you return an item within 30 days of receipt in its original condition, we will refund the amount you paid for it.
Sale items: Please notify us of your return within 14 days by registering it with our online returns partner ZigZag (opens in a new tab), then you have a further 14 days to send it back in its original condition.
Non‑refundable items: Swimwear if the hygiene strip has been removed, and earrings if the internal packaging seal has been broken.
Exchanges: We do not offer exchanges. Simply return your item for a refund and place a new order online.
Orders with pre‑orders: If you return an item from an order that still has a pre‑order outstanding, the cost of the outstanding item may be deducted from your refund, with the remaining balance returned to your original payment method.
365‑day quality guarantee: After the standard returns window, you can return anything that does not meet our quality standards up to one year after your order arrived, for account credit.
